cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

mechanism: A trains its former hosting pupil to treat consent for two relatives as a commitment to an expanding family tea.
confusable: Not merely revealing an uncertain guest list: A uses the original yes to impose concrete extra cups and provisioning as numbers emerge.
comparison: Committee duties derived from chair permission versus hosting six from permission for two.
